Ministries Departments have been advised to review and upgrade their existing capacity-building
frameworks through the AI-enabled Capacity Building Planning (AI-CBP) Tool developed by
In pursuance of the above; a comprehensive designation-wise Annual Capacity Building
Plan (ACBP) for the Officers/Officials of Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
for 2026-27 has been prepared, incorporating/covering Functional, Behavioural and Domain-specific
requirements of the concerned Officers/Officials (ACBP enclosed at Annexure-D)
Accordingly, all Officers/Officials of MoSPI are requested to undertake the courses as per
the designation from the approved ACBP enclosed at Annexure-I in the FY 2026-27. It is also
requested to complete atleast one hour of learning o the iGOT Karmayogi portal every month;
in line with objective Of continuous learning and capacity building;
that  their iGOT Karmayogi profile  remains  updated,
particularly with regard to their current designation, organisation and other relevant details, s0 that
assigned through the ACBP are appropriately mapped. In case of any query o difficulty
respective division/unit may be contacted (Details of nodal officers is placed at Annexure II)
completion of the courses may be regularly monitored by the concerned
Nodal officers/Divisional Heads of respective Divisions
